verdict.rationale: Brex documents issuing both physical and virtual cards to employees, including in 60+ countries with built-in controls. It also documents instant or one-click virtual card creation and bulk virtual card issuance. Spend limits are documented at the individual level through the Budgets/Spend Limits API and limits for individuals and departments, with a community user praising the dynamic card generator. missing for 10: explicit evidence that each card carries its own limit (limits are described per user, budget or department), evidence that physical cards reach the team within minutes, and stronger independent hands-on corroboration.
